jobs.occupation: Order picker in day shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

In this permanent role, you will combine technical product expertise with commercial support, helping dealers, sales teams and customers across Europe find the right fiber laser and press brake solutions.

 You will join a small, approachable and international team at the European headquarters in Brussels. The working environment offers considerable autonomy and short communication lines.

• Collaborate with Sales, Service, Marketing and Product Management.
• Maintain regular contact with international colleagues and stakeholders.The position covers the European market, with approximately one week of international travel per month.
 
 
What do you need? Essential
• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field.
• Experience in a technical, engineering, product management or technical-commercial environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to translate technical challenges into practical solutions.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly to different audiences.
• A customer-focused and commercially minded approach.
• Experience coordinating projects and working with internal and external stakeholders.
• A structured way of working with attention to quality and detail.
• A proactive and results-oriented mindset.
• Fluent Dutch and English.
• Willingness to travel approximately one week per month within Europe.Your strengths
 You are eager to learn and motivated to develop in-depth knowledge of fiber laser, press brake and CNC machine technologies. You enjoy combining technical problem-solving with customer contact and commercial thinking, and you are comfortable working with colleagues and stakeholders across different European markets.

For our client in the food industry, located in the Oudenaarde region, we are looking for an Order Picker who is willing to work in a 3-shift system.

What are we looking for in an Order Picker?
 

 
• You have a good command of English. 
 
• You are comfortable working in a chilled environment of approximately 7°C. 
 
• You can operate an electric pallet truck and a reach truck. 
 
• You are flexible and available to work early, day and late shifts, including occasional Saturdays or Sundays. 
 
• You work accurately: quantities, temperatures, batch numbers and expiry dates must be correct. 
 
• You are able to maintain an overview when several orders need to be prepared at the same time and can determine which tasks should be given priority.
